pr.title: Make cancel_task return immediately with async cleanup
pr.description:
Move synchronous container/worktree cleanup in the PATCH cancel handler
to a background thread so cancel_task returns within the MCP timeout.
The DELETE handler already re-runs cleanup as a safety net.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: New tests verify PATCH returns before cleanup completes, response includes cleanup_pending, and background cleanup runs to completion
- Manual: Cancel a pipeline with 4+ running containers and verify the MCP call returns promptly without timeout
